blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) has largely turned to text generation. We show that competitive dimensional ABSA does not need it. Using Jev, a frozen model that answers typed questions with rubric scores, label probabilities, and yes/no judgments, we decompose all three tasks of SemEval-2026 Task III Track A into such decisions and align them with the annotation scheme through 488 coefficients fitted on CPU, with no text generation and no backbone tuning. On valence--arousal regression over ten corpora in six languages, the system reaches 1.0645 RMSE, the lowest aggregate error of any participating system. On triplet and quadruplet extraction, it reaches 52.09 and 44.06 continuous F1, above fine-tuned Llama-3.3-70B and GPT-OSS-120B baselines. Analyses and ablations show where the accuracy comes from: supervised calibration roughly halves the raw regression error, exact valence--arousal would add only 4.5 F1 to extraction, and the learned combination of span-boundary evidence, not any single signal, carries the extraction systems. 1 1 1 Code: https://github.com/ZhangYiqun018/jev-dimabsa

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Generating sentiment structures has become a prominent approach to aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA). Representative milestones include unified BART-based sequence prediction ( Yan et al., 2021 ) , T5-based paraphrase generation for aspect sentiment quadruples ( Zhang et al., 2021 ) , and multi-view prompting over output orders ( Gou et al., 2023 ) . In a title-filtered audit of the literature (Figure 1 ), the share of methods that use a text-generative model rises from 38% in 2021–2023 to about 65% in 2024–2025. This count includes auxiliary uses such as augmentation and scoring, not only generation of the final tuples. The trend raises a question: does competitive sentiment analysis require generating text?
blocks.zh: 产生情绪结构已成为以方面为基础的情绪分析的突出方法(ABSA)。 具有代表性的里程碑包括统一的基于BART的序列预测(Yan等人,2021年),基于T5的用于侧面情绪四维的参数生成(Zhang等人,2021年),以及多视图提示输出命令. (Gou等人,2023年). 在对文献进行标题过滤的审计(图1)中,使用文本生成模型的方法比例从2021–2023年的38%上升到2024–2025年的65%左右. 这个计数包括辅助用途,如增强和积分,而不仅仅是最后的 tu的生成. 这一趋势提出了一个问题:竞争情绪分析是否需要生成文本?

blocks.en: Before this shift, most ABSA systems were discriminative: an encoder supplied representations for classification or structured selection, as in BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) and its sentence-pair formulation for ABSA ( Sun et al., 2019 ) . When the answer is a label, a span, or a number, direct prediction is a natural fit. Generation offers one output space for all of them, at the price of backbone adaptation, repeated decoding, and output validation.
blocks.zh: 在这次转移之前,大多数ABSA系统是歧视性的:一个编码器提供了用于分类或结构化选择的表示,如BERT(Devlin等人,2019年)及其用于ABSA的句尾配方(Sun等人,2019年). 当答案是一个标签,一个跨度,或者一个数字时,直接预测是自然的适合的. 世代为它们都提供一个输出空间,以主干线改造,重复解码,输出验证为代价.

blocks.en: TypeSafe’s System One framing gives a reason to revisit direct prediction. It presents Jev as a model for fast, structured decisions: given a state and a typed question, it returns an answer with probabilities ( TypeSafe, 2026 ) . This resembles the role of BERT-style classifiers, with a question interface in place of task-specific output heads. We call the interface discriminative without assuming anything about Jev’s architecture or pretraining objective.
blocks.zh: 类型安全系统 一个框架提供了重新审视直接预测的理由。 它提出了Jev作为快速,结构化决定的模型:给定状态和打出的问题,它返回一个有概率的答案(TypeSafe, 2026). 这类似于BERT风格的分类器的作用,一个问题界面取代了特定任务输出头. 我们称界面是歧视性的,

blocks.en: Our testbed is dimensional ABSA. It extends feature-level opinion mining ( Hu and Liu, 2004 ) and polarity-based ABSA ( Pontiki et al., 2014 ; Pontiki et al., 2016 ) with continuous valence and arousal: how positive an evaluation is and how activated the expressed feeling is ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . SemEval-2026 Task III (DimABSA, officially numbered Task 3) defines three increasingly structured tasks in its Track A ( Yu et al., 2026 ) : given-aspect regression (DimASR), aspect–opinion triplet extraction (DimASTE), and categorized quadruplet prediction (DimASQP), which we call Tasks 1–3 (T1–T3 in tables). The latter two credit a tuple only when its spans match exactly, so they test structural prediction as well as numerical estimation.
blocks.zh: 我们的试验床是ABSA维的 它延伸了特征层次的舆论挖掘(Hu和Liu,2004年)和基于极性的ABSA(Pontiki等人,2014年;Pontiki等人,2016年),具有持续的价值和激动:评价有多积极,表达的感觉有多活跃(Lee等人,2026年). 塞姆埃瓦尔-2026 第三任务(DimABSA,正式编号为第三任务)界定了三项结构日益完善的任务 Track A (Yu et al., 2026) : 给定偏差回归 (DimASR), 侧面偏差三重提取 (DimASTE), 和分类四重预测 (DimASQP), 我们称之为任务1–3(表中的T1-T3). 后两者只有在时间跨度完全吻合时才算得上两重,因此它们测试结构预测和数值估计。

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows our system, which decides rather than generates. Training-corpus statistics provide lexical candidates, boundary conventions, demonstrations, and category priors. Jev provides rubric scores, token and category probabilities, and pair judgments. Ridge regression, logistic reranking, and a small fusion model align these decisions with the annotation scheme. No component generates text, as an intermediate or a final answer, and no backbone weights are updated ; the system does use labeled data, through 488 coefficients fitted on CPU.
blocks.zh: 图2显示了我们的系统,它决定而不是产生。 培训-公司统计提供词汇考生、边界惯例、示范和类别前科。 Jev提供标语分数,符号和类别概率,以及对称判断. 山脊回归,后勤重排,以及一个小型的聚变模型使这些决定与注释计划一致. 没有组件生成文本,作为中间或最后的答案,也没有更新主干重;系统确实使用标签数据,通过安装在CPU上的488系数.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: ∙ \bullet A decision-based pipeline for all three tasks that generates no text and tunes no backbone; its task adaptation is 488 coefficients fitted on CPU (Section 3 ). ∙ \bullet The lowest ten-corpus T1 aggregate of any participating system (1.0645 RMSE), and T2/T3 scores (52.09/44.06 cF1) above fine-tuned Llama-3.3-70B and GPT-OSS-120B baselines, over six languages and four domains (Section 4.2 ). ∙ \bullet Ablations and error analysis of where the accuracy comes from: calibration roughly halves the raw regression error, the learned combination of boundary evidence carries extraction (Section 4.3 ), and the remaining extraction error is structural: gold pairs are lost in proposing and in selecting spans, while adding categories costs us less than any leading system (Section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:\Bullet A决策管道,用于所有三项任务,这些任务不产生文字,也不调和主干线;它的任务调整是488个系数,适用于CPU(第3节)。 * 弹夹 任何参与系统的最低10-公司T1总和(1.0645 RSE),以及T2/T3分数(52.09/44.06 cF1),均高于精细调整的Llama-3.3-70B和GPT-OSS-120B基线,分6种语言和4个域(第4.2节)。 校准大致将原始回归误差减半,边界证据的学习结合带萃取(第4.3节),其余的萃取误差是结构性的:在提出和选择跨度时丢失了黄金对,而增加类别的费用则比任何领先系统少(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 ABSA formulations
blocks.zh: 2.1 ABSA制剂

blocks.en: SemEval established aspect-level polarity prediction ( Pontiki et al., 2014 ; Pontiki et al., 2016 ) ; DimABSA extends it to continuous valence–arousal ratings ( Russell, 1980 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) , evaluated jointly with exact tuple structure through continuous F1 ( Yu et al., 2026 ) . Discriminative approaches use BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) , including sentence-pair classification ( Sun et al., 2019 ) . Generative approaches serialize sentiment structures through unified BART prediction ( Yan et al., 2021 ) , T5 paraphrases ( Zhang et al., 2021 ) , or multi-view output-order prompting ( Gou et al., 2023 ) . We revisit direct prediction for all three dimensional tasks, constructing tuples through candidate selection rather than text decoding.
blocks.zh: SemEval建立了侧面级极性预测(Pontiki等人,2014年;Pontiki等人,2016年),DimABSA将其扩展至连续的视率-振奋率(Russell,1980年;Lee等人,2026年),通过连续F1与精确的扭矩结构联合评价(Yu等人,2026年). 歧视性方法使用BERT(Devlin等人,2019年),包括句派分类(Sun等人,2019年). Generative方法通过统一的BART预测(Yan等人,2021年),T5解说(Zhang等人,2021年),或多视图输出顺序提示(Gou等人,2023年),将情绪结构序列化. 我们重新审视对所有三维任务的直接预测,通过候选人选择而不是文本解码来构建拖拉。

blocks.en: 2.2 DimABSA systems and calibration
blocks.zh: 2.2 DimABSA系统和校准

blocks.en: Published systems combine backbone adaptation (PAI, TeleAI, and PALI; Ruan et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Chen, 2026 ), retrieved demonstrations and ensembling (Takoyaki; Yamada et al., 2026 ), or repeated structured generation (nchellwig; Hellwig et al., 2026 ). TeamLasse separates generative extraction from encoder-based VA regression ( Strothe, 2026 ) ; Table 1 summarizes each system’s adaptation. Our pipeline combines BM25-retrieved annotation examples ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) with Jev’s fixed Score , Choice , and Noul interfaces ( TypeSafe, 2026 ) . Unlike contextual calibration, which estimates answer bias from content-free inputs ( Zhao et al., 2021 ) , our VA calibration fits benchmark labels: its gains rely on supervision as well as prompting.
blocks.zh: 出版系统结合骨干适应(PAI,TeleAI,和PALI;Ruan等人,2026年;Zhou等人,2026年;Chen,2026年),检索演示和综艺(Takoyaki;Yamada等人,2026年),或重复结构化生成(Chellwig;Hellwig等人,2026年)。 TeamLasse将基因提取与基于编码器的VA回归(Strothe, 2026年)分开;表1总结了每个系统的适应性. 我们的管道将BM25检索的注释实例(Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009)与Jev的固定分数、选择和Noul接口(TypeSafe, 2026)结合起来。 我们的VA校准符合基准标签:其收益既依赖于监管,也取决于激励。

blocks.en: A pair judgment says whether a relation is plausible, but the metric also requires the dataset’s exact boundaries. Further Noul questions therefore ask whether a candidate is exactly one annotated phrase and whether a pair follows the dataset’s relation convention. Their context includes four same-corpus training reviews retrieved by BM25. Each check is repeated with character-bigram, character-trigram, and word retrieval, using Jieba for Chinese words. Opinion candidates are also extended by up to three tokens to the left and two to the right, with no internal punctuation and at most 12 tokens; an extension enters the pair pool when its span check is at least 0.5.

blocks.en: Table 1 compares our system with six participant systems and three model baselines evaluated by Lee et al. (2026) . It is the only system that neither tunes a backbone nor generates text in any task: its whole task adaptation is 488 coefficients fitted on CPU (100 in the Task 1 ridge models, 332 in the Task 2 rerankers, 32 in the pair-level VA maps, and 24 in category fusion). Because the competition ranks each corpus separately, we reconstruct participant aggregates from the published per-corpus scores. The systems also differ in backbone and supervision, so the comparison places our results in context rather than isolating the effect of generation.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Deciding instead of generating is enough for competitive dimensional ABSA. With Jev’s typed decisions, corpus statistics, and 488 coefficients fitted on CPU, our system obtains the lowest ten-corpus Task 1 aggregate of any participating system and outperforms fine-tuned Llama-3.3-70B and GPT-OSS-120B baselines on extraction, without text generation or backbone tuning. What makes it work is alignment with the annotation scheme : a few coefficients per corpus put the model’s scores on the gold scale, the remaining extraction error lies in proposing and selecting span boundaries rather than in sentiment values or categories, and ablations show that the learned combination of boundary evidence carries extraction. Closing that gap, and comparing the latency and cost of decision composition with generative systems under matched conditions, are the natural next steps.
blocks.zh: 决定而不是生成 足够竞争性维度ABSA。 使用Jev的输入式决定、实体统计和CPU上的488个系数,我们的系统获得了最低的十大任务1总和参与系统,并且优于Llama-3.3-70B和GPT-OSS-120B的提取基线,没有文本生成或主干线调试。 其作用在于与注解方案保持一致:每个标本的几个系数将模型的分数放在黄金尺度上,剩下的提取错误在于提出和选择跨边界,而不是情绪值或类别,而浮标表明,学到的边界证据组合包含提取。 缩小这一差距,并在相应条件下将决策构成的延迟性和成本与基因系统进行比较,是下一个自然步骤。

blocks.en: The implemented inventory contains 14 English restaurant categories, 12 categories in the other restaurant corpora, 44 Japanese hotel categories, and 113–121 laptop categories. These counts come from the eligible training pools, not from a canonical label scheme. Fitting samples accumulate complete training reviews until at least 1,000 annotated pairs are covered per corpus. Count features leave out all annotations sharing the sampled review’s normalized text. Retrieved demonstrations also omit that text, but the category glossary is built from the whole eligible training pool, so the sampled text is not removed from every glossary entry. Each of the four category variants refits its own fusion weights; “model + prior” is therefore not the raw model argmax.
blocks.zh: 已执行的库存包括14个英文餐厅类别、其他餐厅的12个类别、44个日本旅馆类别和113-121个膝上型计算机类别。 这些计数来自合格的培训人才库,而不是来自犬科标签计划。 装配样品累积了完整的培训审查,直到至少1 000对附加说明的样本被覆盖。 计数特性不包含所有共享抽样审查规范文本的说明。 检索到的演示也省略了该文本,但分类词汇是从整个合格培训池中构建的,因此样本文本并没有从每个词汇条目中删除. 四个类别的变体中,每个变体都重新调整了自身的聚变重量;因此,“模型+前”不是原始模型矩形。

blocks.en: The exact-VA diagnostic in Table 2 scores our extracted pairs with gold VA. It removes numerical error on structurally matched predictions and keeps the extracted pairs unchanged, so it bounds what improving VA alone can gain for that pair set; it says nothing about candidate coverage, recall, or category selection. Category accuracy likewise conditions on matched pairs and ignores missing or spurious pairs. In our results, the ratio of Task 3 to Task 2 cF1 is close to this conditional accuracy, but not identical to it, because VA weights and gold tuple counts also enter.

blocks.en: Table 7: Annual paper counts behind Figure 1 . G: the proposed method uses a text-generative model; D: it does not; Other: latent methods or unresolved model use. Years without included papers are omitted.

blocks.en: Figure 1 describes a bounded corpus, not all of ABSA. We searched ACL Anthology metadata for ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, EACL, and COLING main proceedings and associated Findings published in 2004–2025, including LREC-COLING 2024. The case-insensitive title rule requires both “aspect” and “sentiment”, or the standalone abbreviation “ABSA”. Workshops and demonstrations are outside the scope. The start year follows early feature-level opinion mining ( Hu and Liu, 2004 ) ; matching papers begin in 2008. The Anthology snapshot is commit 51279f83 , retrieved September 28, 2026.
blocks.zh: 图1说明的是受约束的人身,而不是ABSA的全部。 我们搜索了ACL、EMNLP、NAACL、EACL的Anthology元数据,以及2004-2025年出版的包括LREC-COLLING 2024在内的COLING主要程序和相关调查结果。 对案件不敏感的标题规则既要求“旁观”又要求“同意”,或要求单独简称“ABSA”。 讲习班和示威活动不在范围之内。 开始的一年是早期地物层次的民意调查(Hu and Liu,2004年);2008年开始配对论文. 2026年9月28日检索。

blocks.en: We additionally searched official AAAI, NeurIPS, and ICML proceedings for 2004–2025 and ICLR conference programs for 2013–2025 with the same rule. AAAI’s older directories were retrieved through a public reader proxy; AAAI was not held in 2009. ICLR, NeurIPS, and ICML produced no matching titles, which does not mean they publish no ABSA research. Source URLs, retrieval hashes, track filters, and zero-hit records are preserved in the audit directory.
blocks.zh: 我们以同样的规则搜索了官方AAAI、NeurIPS和ICML2004-2025年的程序以及ICLR2013-2025年的会议程序。 AAAI的旧目录通过公共读者代理检索;AAAI在2009年没有举办. ICLR,NeurIPS,以及ICML没有制作匹配标题,这并不意味着他们没有发表ABSA的研究. 原始URL,检索散列,跟踪过滤器,零重击记录在审计目录中保存.

blocks.en: The combined search returned 293 venue-eligible candidates: 261 from the Anthology and 32 from AAAI. We excluded 16 dataset-only, diagnostic, or non-ABSA-prediction papers, leaving 277 papers. Task or dataset papers remain eligible when they introduce or adapt an actual predictor or training intervention. Each included paper contributes once, regardless of the number of proposed variants or evaluated tasks. Models used only as comparison baselines or mentioned in related work do not affect its category.
blocks.zh: 综合搜索结果使293名符合场地条件的候选人返回,其中261名来自人类学,32名来自澳大利亚宇航科学院。 我们排除了16份只有数据集、诊断文件或非ABSA预测文件,留下277份。 任务或数据集文件在引入或调整实际预测器或培训干预措施时仍符合资格。 每个文件都提供了一次文件,而不论提议的变式或评价的任务的数目。 仅用作比较基线或相关工作中提到的模型不影响其类别。

blocks.en: Generative means that a proposed method or its tested variant uses a text-generative model at any stage: resource construction, training augmentation, representation extraction, candidate scoring, preprocessing, or task inference. Mixed pipelines count as Generative even when their final task head is discriminative. This includes GPT-, T5-, and BART-family models, translation systems, and autoregressive language-model features such as ELMo and XLNet. Using only the encoder of a text-generative pretrained model also qualifies. The category thus measures model use, not whether a system generates text at inference.
blocks.zh: generative是指拟议方法或其测试的变体在任何阶段都使用文本生成模式:资源构建,培训增强,代表提取,候选评分,预处理,或任务推论. 混合管道即使其最终任务负责人具有歧视性,也算作基因管道。 这包括GPT-,T5-和BART-family模型,翻译系统,以及ELMo和XLNet等自动递归语言模型功能. 只使用文本生成前训练过的模型的编码器也符合条件。 因此,该类衡量模型的使用,而不是一个系统是否产生推断的文本.

blocks.en: Discriminative covers direct label, rating, tag, span, table, or action decisions without identified text-generative model use. BERT/RoBERTa masked-language-model encoders do not qualify as text-generative models under this codebook; neither does masked-token substitution alone. A task-specific pointer or transition decoder without a text-generative language model is not automatically Generative. Early statistical topic models, VAEs, and RBMs also do not qualify merely because they have a probabilistic generative formulation. Latent/discovery approaches are retained as Other ; a discriminative predictor using a latent auxiliary objective remains Discriminative unless a text-generative model is also used.
blocks.zh: 歧视包括直接标签、评级、标记、跨度、表格或行动决定,而不使用已查明的文本生成模式。 BERT/ROBERTA 遮盖语言-模型编码器在此编码本下不合格为文本生成模型;单是遮盖脚趾替换也不符合条件. 没有文本生成语言模型的任务特定指针或过渡解码器并不自动是Generative. 早期的统计专题模型、脆弱经济体和成果管理制也并非仅仅因为有概率的基因配制而有资格。 原始/发现方法作为其他方法保留;使用潜在辅助目标的歧视性预测器仍然具有歧视性,除非也使用文本生成模型。

blocks.en: We also retain unresolved model use as Other rather than assuming that an undisclosed component is non-generative. For example, UGTS names AMRLib and GraphMerge names the Berkeley parser without specifying a checkpoint. Conversely, APARN names SPRING, whose documented BART backbone establishes Generative preprocessing. Other contains 11 latent/discovery papers and nine papers with unresolved model use.
blocks.zh: 我们还保留了未解决的模型作为其他用途,而不是假设一个未披露的组件是非遗传性的。 例如,UGTS将AMRLib和GraphMorge命名为伯克利解析器,但没有指定检查点. 相反,APARN名称SPRING,其文件记载的BART主干线建立了Generative预处理. 其他文件载有11份潜在/发现文件和9份尚未解决的模型使用文件。

blocks.en: Publisher full texts were temporarily unavailable for part of the AAAI expansion. Of its 30 included papers, 12 were checked against full texts, ten against author or associated implementations and dependency documentation, and one topic model against its abstract. Seven remain unresolved; their abstracts establish task eligibility but cannot establish absence of text-generative dependencies. These papers stay in the denominator. Individual records distinguish evidence types and link the inspected sources.
blocks.zh: 部分AAAI扩展版暂时没有出版物全文。 在其30份文件中,12份与全文核对,10份与作者或相关执行和依赖性文件核对,1份与摘要对照。 7项仍未解决;其摘要规定了任务资格,但不能确定不存在来源于文本的依赖关系。 这些文件留在分母。 个别记录区分证据类型,并将被检查来源联系起来。

blocks.en: The figure pools papers within five publication periods. Each percentage divides the category count by all included papers in that period, retaining Other in the denominator. Table 7 gives annual counts; no observation is imputed for years without matching papers. In 2024–2025, 53 of 82 papers have identified text-generative use and four remain unresolved. Assigning all four to Generative would raise that share from 64.6% to 69.5%.
blocks.zh: 图中汇集了五个出版期间的论文. 每一百分比将类别数除以该期间的所有文件,其他部分保留在分母中。 表7列出年度清点数;如果没有匹配的证件,则无法估计多年的观察。 在2024–2025年,82份论文中有53份确定了文字生成用途,4份仍未解决. 将全部四人分配给基因组,将使这一份额从64.6%提高到69.5%。

blocks.en: The early 2004–2013 period contains only four papers and cannot establish the field’s original method distribution. Unequal period lengths, evolving venue coverage, title vocabulary, and changing task composition further limit interpretation. Coding was model-assisted with targeted source checks, without independent double annotation, so no inter-annotator agreement is available. The accompanying analysis/absa-trend/ directory provides titles, links, evidence, exclusions, and the counting protocol. The figure builder computes percentages directly from those records.
blocks.zh: 2004-2013年初期,只有四篇论文,无法确定实地最初的方法分布。 时间跨度不均,会场覆盖面、职称词汇和任务构成的变化进一步限制了解释。 编码被模型协助进行定向源码检查,没有独立的双倍注解,因此无法获得通知人之间的协议. 所附分析/absa-trend/目录提供标题、链接、证据、排除和计数协议。 数字构建者直接根据这些记录计算百分比。

blocks.en: E.1 Shared valence–arousal rubrics
blocks.zh: E.1 共有价值 -- -- 激励面额

blocks.en: Both Task 1 and the pair-scoring stage of Task 2 use type: score , with the ordered criteria in Table 8 . These nine level descriptions are our rubric; the 1–9 scale and the short dimension definitions below follow the benchmark ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . The returned expected index is zero-based and is shifted by one before calibration (Equation 1 ).
blocks.zh: 任务1和任务2的对分阶段都使用类型:分数,按顺序标准列于表8。 这9个级别说明是我们的标题;1–9尺度和下面的短维定义遵循基准(Lee等人,2026年)。 返回的预期指数基于零,在校准(方程式1 )前移动一个.

blocks.en: Table 8: Verbatim ordered criteria for the shared Score questions. Level numbers show the benchmark scale; the API criterion indices are 0–8.

blocks.en: The corresponding sentence is appended to the question: Valence: 1 = most negative, 9 = most positive. Arousal: 1 = calm/low intensity, 9 = excited/high intensity.
blocks.zh: 问题后面附有相应的句子: 瓦伦斯:1=最阴,9=最阳. 激发:1=平静/低强度, 9=兴奋/高强度.

blocks.en: The instructions.focus field ends with the following text for valence and arousal, respectively: Judge only the sentiment directed at this aspect; ignore sentiment toward any other aspect in the text. Judge only the feeling directed at this aspect; ignore feeling toward any other aspect in the text. Arousal is how activated that feeling is -- how calm or how excited -- not how positive or negative it is.
blocks.zh: 指示。焦点字段结尾分别以下列文字表示: 只评判针对这一方面的情绪;无视案文中任何其他方面的情绪。 仅判断针对这一方面的感受;忽略了案文中任何其他方面的感受。 激动人心的是,这种感觉是如何激活的, 是多么的平静或多么兴奋, 而不是它有多积极或消极。

blocks.en: For VA questions, the aspect "{aspect}" becomes the following phrase when the aspect is NULL : the aspect that is left implicit and never named in the text
blocks.zh: 对于 VA 问题,当问题为 NULL 时, “{aspect} ” 的一面成为下面的短语 : 在文本中被隐含且从未命名的一面

blocks.en: E.2 Task 1: given-aspect regression
blocks.zh: E.2 任务1:特定回归

blocks.en: The state has two fields: review_to_score contains the input review, and labelled_examples contains nine fixed training demonstrations. Each demonstration has review , aspect , valence , and arousal fields; the two numeric labels are rounded to two decimals. Selection follows Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 该州有两个领域:审查_to_score包含输入审查,标签_例子包含9个固定训练演示. 每个演示都有回顾,方面,价值,以及激发字段;两个数字标签是四舍五入到两个小数. 第3节之后选定。

blocks.en: For each given aspect, the two instructions.question fields begin as follows: What valence given the aspect "{aspect}" in ‘review_to_score‘? What arousal given the aspect "{aspect}" in ‘review_to_score‘? Each question then appends its dimension definition from Appendix E.1 and this calibration clause: The 9 entries in ‘labelled_examples‘ are already-scored (review, aspect) pairs; use them only to calibrate the 1-9 scale. Both instructions.focus fields prepend the following text to the corresponding dimension-specific focus: ‘labelled_examples‘ are for calibration only -- do not score them. Score only the aspect named in this question, as it appears in ‘review_to_score‘. The earlier zero-shot variant uses the review string alone as state , omits in ‘review_to_score‘ from the question, and omits both demonstration-related additions. Other demonstration-count variants substitute the actual number for nine.
blocks.zh: 对于每个给定的方面,两个指示. 问题字段起始如下: 在“ 检讨_ 分数” 中“ { spect} ” 方面有什么价值 ? 在“ 检讨_ 分数” 中“ { aspect} ” 方面有什么意义 ? 每个问题随附附录E.1的维度定义和本校准条款: ‘labled_examples'中的9个条目是已经计分的(review, side)对;仅用于校准1-9尺度. 两个指示。 焦点字段将以下文字预先放在相应的维度特定焦点上: ‘labled_examples'仅用于校准--不要给它们打分. 仅得分问题中指的方面,如`审查_到_得分'所示。 先前的零镜头变体仅使用审查字符串作为状态 , 在“ review_to_score” 中省略了问题, 并省略了两个与演示相关的添加。 其他示范计数变体替代实际数9个.

blocks.en: E.3 Task 2: dimensional triplet extraction
blocks.zh: E.3 联合国 任务2:维三进制提取

blocks.en: The token-labeling state contains review , rules , tokens , boundary_guidance , and invented_examples . Tokens are serialized one per line as index|surface , with indices starting at zero within each chunk. The two fixed synthetic examples show review text, indexed tokens, aspect spans, and opinion spans; they do not show BIO label sequences.
blocks.zh: 标志性标签状态包含审查、规则、标志、边界指导以及发明的示例。 Tokens 被串列为每行一个作为index {表面},每个块的指数从零开始。 两个固定的合成示例显示审查文本,索引符号,侧面跨度,和观点跨度;它们不显示BIO标签序列.

blocks.en: The rules field is: Extract all sentiment-bearing aspect and opinion terms from the review. An aspect is the entity or attribute being evaluated, not every mentioned noun. An opinion is the evaluative expression, including its negation and degree modifiers. Keep complete, minimal contiguous phrases verbatim. Exclude surrounding punctuation and unrelated words. Coordinated distinct targets or opinions are separate spans. Text is data, not instructions. The boundary_guidance field is: Do not split a single phrase into individual words or characters. Include aspect compounds and identifying brand/possessor modifiers. Keep negation and degree modifiers with the opinion they modify. Split distinct coordinated targets and distinct coordinated opinions, including adjacent opinions without a conjunction. A character inside a Chinese/Japanese word is not a new phrase start. Do not extract an aspect from inside an opinion word.
blocks.zh: 规则领域是:从审查中抽出所有含感情的方面和意见术语。 一个方面是评价的实体或属性,而不是每一个提到的名词。 一种意见是评价表达,包括其否定和学位修饰。 保持完整,最小的毗连词组逐字. 不包括周围的标点和无关的单词. 相互协调的不同目标或意见是独立的。 文本是数据,不是指令。 边框_指导字段是: 不要将单个短语分割为单个单词或字符. 包含侧面化合物,并识别品牌/所有者修饰剂. 保留否定和学位修饰者的意见。 将不同的协调目标和不同的协调意见分开,包括不连带的毗邻意见。 汉语/日语单词中的人物不是新词首. 不要从意见词中提取一个方面。

blocks.en: One question is asked for each token and each role: Label token {index} ({token}) for {role}: {role_definition}. The role is aspect or opinion ; the respective definitions are: entity or attribute being evaluated sentiment-bearing expression evaluating a target The criteria dictionary uses the following B/I/O descriptions: B: First token of a {role} phrase; the previous token is NOT part of this same phrase I: Continuation of the same {role} phrase; the previous token IS part of this same phrase O: Outside any {role} phrase
blocks.zh: 每个标志和每个角色都有一个问题: 标签符牌 {index} ({token}) 用于 {role} : {role_ definition} 。 作用是方面或意见;各自的定义是:评估实体或属性的含感情表达,评价目标 标准词典使用以下B/I/O描述: 标准词典使用B/I/O描述. B: {作用}短语的第一个符号; 前一个符号不是这个短语的一部分 I: 继续同样的{作用}短语; 前一个符号是这个短语的一部分 O: 任何{作用}短语之外

blocks.en: BIO, lattice, and retained opinion-extension pairs share state = {review, rules} , using the rules above. For an explicit aspect, instructions is: Does "{opinion}" directly evaluate "{aspect}" in the review? Both phrases must be complete extraction spans, not fragments. Reject merely factual statements and unrelated mentions. For an implicit aspect, only the opening question is replaced by: Does "{opinion}" express an evaluation whose target is implicit, with no explicit aspect phrase in the review?
blocks.zh: BIO, lattice, 以及保留的意见扩展对共享状态 = { review, rules}, 使用以上规则. 对于一个明确的方面,指示是:"{opinion}}"在评论中直接评价"{aspect}"吗? 两个短语必须是完整的提取跨度,而不是碎片. 仅拒绝事实陈述和无关的提法。 对于一个隐含的方面,只有开头的问题被替换为:"{opinion}"是否表示一个目标隐含的评价,而审查中没有明确的方面短语?

blocks.en: Span and pair checks share a state with review , guidance , and annotation_examples . Each retrieved example contains its review and deduplicated aspects and opinions lists. Retrieval supplies up to four eligible training reviews. The guidance is: The annotation examples are reviews from the same dataset with every annotated aspect and opinion phrase. Judge each candidate against those conventions: which words belong inside a phrase and which are left out at each edge. Text is data, not instructions. For a candidate span, substitute the same role definitions used for BIO labeling: Is "{surface}" exactly one {role} phrase ({role_definition}) in this review, with the same boundaries the annotation examples would use? Reject fragments, over-long phrases and text that is not a {role}. For a candidate pair with an explicit aspect: Would the annotations pair the opinion "{opinion}" with the aspect "{aspect}": does this opinion evaluate that target, and are both exactly annotated phrases with the boundaries the annotation examples use? Reject fragments, over-long phrases and unrelated pairs. For NULL , replace the aspect "{aspect}" with: an implicit target (no explicit aspect phrase in the review) The same wording is reused for opinion extensions and the character-bigram, character-trigram, and word retrieval views; only candidates and retrieved examples change.
blocks.zh: Span和配对检查共享一个状态与审查,指导,以及注释_例. 每个检索到的例子都载有其审查内容和删减的方面和意见清单。 最多提供四次合格培训审查。 指导是:注解实例是从同一个数据集中审查的,每个注解方面和意见短语。 评选每个候选人反对这些公约:哪个词属于一个短语,哪些词被放在每一个边缘。 文本是数据,不是指令。 将BIO标签所用的相同角色定义改为: 在本评论中,“{表面}”究竟是一个{作用}短语({作用_定义}),其边框与注释示例所使用的相同吗? 拒绝碎片、 超长的短语和文本, 而非 {作用} 。 对于一对具有明确方面内容的候选人: 注释是否将“{opinion}”与“{aspect}”的一面相配 : 此注释是否评价了目标, 并且都是带有注释示例所用的边界的精确注释短语 ? 拒绝碎片,超长的短语和无关的对子. 对 NULL , 将“ {aspect} ” 改为: 隐含的目标( 在评论中没有明确的侧面短语) 同样的措辞被重新用于意见扩展和字符比格法,字符比格法,以及文字检索视图;只有候选人和检索到的例子才有变化.

blocks.zh: 表9:任务3类别模板中的逐字记录属性说明。 只有符合资格的培训人才有选择。

blocks.en: The final reranker also consumes probabilities from the earlier lexical baseline, whose state is the review string. This baseline uses a distinct instructions.question : Does the opinion phrase "{opinion}" express sentiment directly toward the aspect "{aspect}" in this review? Its instructions.focus is: Both must be explicit complete aspect/opinion spans. Reject unrelated pairs, incomplete fragments and factual mentions without an evaluative opinion.
blocks.zh: 最终的重新排序器也从早期的词典基线中消耗概率,其状态是审查字符串. 这一基准使用不同的说明。 问题: 观点短语"{opinion}}"是否表达出本评论中直接对"{aspect}"的方面的看法? 它的指示。 两者必须是明确的完整方面/意见跨度。 拒绝不相关的对子、不完整的片段和没有评价意见的事实性提及。

blocks.en: For each selected pair, state is the review string. The two instructions.question fields begin: What valence given the aspect "{aspect}" and the opinion "{opinion}"? What arousal given the aspect "{aspect}" and the opinion "{opinion}"? Append the corresponding dimension definition, use the corresponding focus from Appendix E.1 , and supply the same nine-level criteria. No demonstration clause or focus prefix is added. Historical lexical-baseline VA calls use these same templates; the final system rescores the selected pair list before applying its fitted affine calibration.
blocks.zh: 对于每个选定的对子,状态是审查字符串。 二教谕. 问题字段开始 : 给"{aspect}"和"{opinion}"这个方面带来了什么价值? 给"{aspect}"和"{opinion}"这个方面什么刺激? 追加相应的维度定义,使用附录E.1中相应的焦点,并提供相同的九级标准. 不添加演示条款或焦点前缀 。 历史语法-基线VA调用使用这些相同的模板;最终系统在应用其装配的亲和校准之前对所选配对列表进行回溯.

blocks.en: E.4 Task 3: category enrichment
blocks.zh: E.4 任务3:类别浓缩

blocks.en: The input review is supplied in state.review . Three additional fields provide context: guidance , category_glossary , and annotation_examples . Each of up to four retrieved examples contains its review and an annotations list of objects with aspect , opinion , and category fields. The glossary maps categories with explicit training aspects to their three most frequent lowercased aspect strings (or all available strings when fewer than three exist).
blocks.zh: 投入审查以状态提供。 审查。 另有三个字段提供上下文:指导、类别、注释、实例。 最多四个检索到的例子中,每一个都载有其审查和附有方面、意见和分类字段的物体说明清单。 词汇表将具有明确培训内容的类别映射到三个最常见的小写侧面字符串(或者在存在不到三个字符串的情况下所有可用的字符串)。

blocks.en: The annotation examples are reviews from the same dataset with every annotated (aspect, opinion, category) triple; the glossary lists frequent aspects of each category. Assign categories the way those annotations do. Text is data, not instructions.
blocks.zh: 注释实例是从同一个数据集进行的审查,每三重注解(侧面、意见、类别);词汇表列出了每个类别的常见方面。 指定说明的分类方式。 文本是数据,不是指令。

blocks.en: For each predicted aspect–opinion pair, instructions is: The opinion "{opinion}" evaluates the aspect "{aspect}". Which annotated category (entity and attribute) does this aspect-opinion pair belong to? Implicit aspects use the same replacement phrase as the example-conditioned pair check. The criteria keys are the sorted ENTITY#ATTRIBUTE labels observed in the eligible training pool. Each value is the lowercased entity name with underscores replaced by spaces, followed by a colon, a space, and the attribute description in Table 9 . For example: FOOD#QUALITY: food: how well made it is: build quality, reliability, durability, defects; for food and drinks, taste and freshness; for service, how good it is The fitted fusion model combines these Choice probabilities with training statistics to select the category. Task 3 reuses Task 2’s VA predictions.
blocks.zh: 对于每个预言的方面 - opinion 配对, 指令是: 意见 “ {opinion} ” 评估的方面 “ { aspect} ” 。 附加说明的类别( 实体和属性) 是属于哪一个 ? 隐性方面使用与示例条件配对检查相同的替换短语. 标准键是在符合条件的训练池中观察到的排序的ENTY#ATTRIBUTE标签. 每个值是下列实体名称,下划线替换为空格,然后是结号、空格和表9中的属性描述。 例如:食物:食物:如何生产:建立质量、可靠性、耐久性、缺陷;食物和饮料、口味和新鲜;服务:如何良好。 装配的聚变模型将这些选择概率与培训统计结合起来来选择该类别. 任务3重复使用任务2的VA预测.
